conviction_note: A slight positive lean, 55% up on a 5.0% scale. The yen averaged about 159.5 over H1 against the plan's stated 145 assumption, and Q1 operating profit was already 60% of the H1 plan, so the H1 beat and a possible FY sales/OP raise are the upside. The offset is that the company is cautious on guidance, and last year's Q2 print turned on FX and derivative non-operating losses (-10.7% on the day). The yen strengthened from 161.9 to 157.4 over Jul-Sep, so the same line could swing again. The findings sum to +0.7 and the scaled number is +0.5; they agree in sign and differ little.
bar: Company H1 plan (no analyst consensus exists; kabuyoho shows '--' for consensus; 四季報 unreachable): H1 sales 30,000 / OP 1,800 / ordinary 2,700 / NP 700 (million yen); FY sales 61,600 / OP 6,000 / ordinary 5,000 / NP 2,100. Source: Q1 決算短信 https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260729/140120260729501426.pdf. print_vs_bar is H1 operating profit vs 1,800 (estimate ~2,000-2,100). The only bar is the company plan, so every finding is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register 2026-10-27: 0.0% (no disclosed position >=0.5%), unchanged. Margin ratio null in the baseline. kabutan lists the name as 制度信用, buy-side only (not 貸借), so there are no margin shorts to squeeze. Zenar Asset Management raised its stake to 6.20% (from 5.05%) on 2026-08-24, with stated engagement intent. Controlling shareholder 明海興産 has been adding through 2025. Run-up 20d +0.48%, 5d +0.88%; priced_lean -0.024. Since the August theme spike to 1,327 the stock has round-tripped to about 1,037. No option skew exists.

findings.finding: The plan is built on a strong-yen assumption (FY tanshin: '為替円高想定'; the 2026-07-23 notice states 1US$=145 as the FY-end assumed rate), but USD/JPY averaged ~159.4 in Apr-Jun and ~159.3 in Jul-Sep. Q1 OP of 1,077 already covers 60% of the 1,800 H1 OP plan, leaving only 723 needed in Q2 against 812 in Q2 FY26 at ~147 yen. So H1 sales/OP should beat the plan, and the FX gap gives the company room to raise FY sales/OP at this print, as it raised FY sales on a weak yen at the Q2 FY26 print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-01-29 Q3 OP exceeded the FY plan: +5.17% on the day (13:00 release). 2026-07-29 Q1 OP -50% YoY despite 60% H1 progress: -6.46% day, -7.4% over 2 days. 2025-10-31 FY sales raised but OP held and ordinary/NP cut: -10.7% day. The company held its FY plan at Q3 FY26 even when OP had exceeded it, so it is conservative about raising.
findings.why_not_priced: The yen level is public, but no analyst publishes a number on this name (kabuyoho consensus '--'), so nobody has translated the 145-vs-159 gap into an earnings bar. Over 20 days the stock is flat and well below its August theme peak. If an FY raise were in the price you would expect a run-in into the print, and there is none.
findings.independence: July 23 notice confirming the 145 assumed rate: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260723/140120260723597996.pdf. Q1 progress figures: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9115&b=k202607290009. The FX series is Yahoo JPY=X. All of these restate the same plan.

findings.finding: Non-operating FX/derivative swing risk. At the Q2 FY26 print the company booked an H1 FX loss of 1,434 and a derivative loss of 628 on foreign-currency debt and FX forwards, missed its H1 ordinary plan by 60%, and cut FY ordinary by 71% and NP by 25%. This year the yen moved from 161.92 (6/30) to 157.40 (9/30), so Q1's 492m derivative gain could reverse into Q2. Q2 needs 1,030 of ordinary profit to meet the 2,700 H1 plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-31: FX-driven ordinary/NP cut, -10.7% on the day and -15.7% over 2 days. This is the one precedent on this line, and it is the name's largest reaction in the sample.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody models the sign of this company's FX exposure. Its quarterly non-operating swings do not map cleanly onto the yen's direction (Q1 FY26 lost on FX as the yen strengthened; Q1 FY27 gained on derivatives as it weakened), so the market cannot compute it. That ambiguity is also why this finding is small: the direction is an inference, not a document.
findings.independence: Q1 FY27 tanshin non-operating lines (derivative gain 492, FX gain 29): https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260729/140120260729501426.pdf. This is the same company's filings, not an independent series.

findings.finding: H1 net profit will beat the 700m plan by a wide margin: Q1 alone booked 899m, helped by a 913m ship-sale gain that was in the plan. A 差異 notice for H1 is therefore near-certain, but it was computable from the Q1 短信.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-07-30: Q1 NP already over the H1 plan, +5.71% on the day. The 2026-07-29 Q1 that showed the same overshoot fell 6.46% on the OP decline instead.
findings.why_not_priced: It largely is priced: the overshoot has been public since July 29. The only thing left is the formal variance notice and the headline (kabutan will lead with H1 ordinary up several-fold from 357m last year), which may draw retail flow.
findings.independence: Q1 tanshin: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260729/140120260729501426.pdf. This is the same document.

findings.finding: Shareholder-return optionality. The FY dividend is still '未定' (it was 5 yen last year, about 0.5% yield, 4% payout) with PBR at 0.64, and UK investor Zenar Asset Management lifted its stake to 6.20% on 2026-08-24 with a stated intent to propose capital-efficiency improvements. A dividend or return-policy announcement with the H1 results is possible but undated.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-02-28: the company set the undecided dividend at 5 yen alongside a FY raise, and the stock closed the day off its lows. On 2026-09-01 the stock rose on Zenar's stake increase. No H1-print return announcement on record.
findings.why_not_priced: The company has historically decided its dividend in February, not October, so the market does not expect anything at this print. If a policy change were anticipated, the stock would not have drifted down 20% from its August level into the release. This is an inference with no document saying it will happen, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Zenar's stated engagement purpose: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9115&b=n202609010277. The 未定 dividend: the Q1 tanshin. Both are different documents, and neither says anything will happen at this print.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: possible. The company revised FY at the Q2 print in FY24 and FY26 (FY26: sales up, OP held, ordinary/NP down on FX), and the 145-yen assumption leaves room to raise sales/OP, but this management holds plans even when they are exceeded. Returns: FY dividend 未定, normally set in February; Zenar 6.2% engagement is the only push. New-year guide: n/a (H1). Quarter vs own 進捗率: Q1 ordinary progress against H1 was 61.9% vs 84.0% (FY25) and 521.6% (FY26), but those years were driven by one-offs, so the comparison is noisy. H1 OP needs only 723 in Q2 against 812 a year earlier at a stronger yen.

baseline_tension: This lean cuts mildly against nothing: positioning is empty (zero disclosed shorts, buy-only margin), the run-up is flat and priced_lean is -0.02. The strongest positive the release could carry is an FY sales/OP raise on the weak yen, or a dividend/return change pushed by Zenar; I looked for both and found room for the first and no dated evidence of the second. The strongest negative is a repeat of last year's FX-driven non-operating miss.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a visible series is priced), applied symmetrically to positives: the H1 NP overshoot is computable from the Q1 短信, so 0.2 went to 0.1. The FX/progress finding went from 1.0 to 0.8 because its quarter half is computable; what is left is the revision, which the release has to add.
Rule 2 (check the sign): only one of four findings is negative. The strongest positive (FY raise / returns) is written into baseline_tension; p_up stays at 55 and abs_move at 5.0.
